analyst_view.overall: Real Madrid are 2nd on a perfect 12 points under Jose Mourinho and beat Celta 2-1 on Saturday; Mourinho confirmed Vinicius starts (his domestic ban does not apply in Europe), and Valverde, Cucurella and Tchouameni come back after being rested. Rodrygo, Asencio and Endrick are out (Rodrygo and Endrick counted), and two Spanish previews say Dumfries, who missed training, will not play; one preview has Brahim starting instead of Arda Guler after Mourinho called Guler and Bellingham 'physically destroyed', while most still have both starting. PSV are 24th on 4 points and lead the Eredivisie, but captain Mauro Junior is out (counted, about -4% on PSV's goals) with teenager Noah Fernandez expected to replace him; Dest is a slight doubt after coming off at half-time at NEC, and Schouten, Nagalo, Plea and Ouaissa remain out. Norwegian referee Espen Eskas, an average carder, is in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say a high 4.5 goals, built on Madrid's strong recent scoring and PSV's open style under Bosz, and they already take a little off PSV for Mauro Junior. Madrid's front line of Mbappe, Vinicius and Bellingham is expected to start, with only Guler possibly swapped for Brahim, and PSV keep their attack from the 4-1 at NEC, so nothing changes the picture. I stay at 4.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners and already trim PSV (-6%) for their low recent count against strong defences. Valverde back at right-back adds width for Madrid and Perisic and Van Bommel give PSV wide threat, which is their normal shape and already in the records, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, close to both teams' usual rates, and include Espen Eskas, whose record is about average. A young PSV midfield with Fernandez in for the captain could have to foul more to stop Madrid's runners, but that is a guess, there is no needle between the clubs and no ban in play, so I stay at 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.0 shots, including Madrid's heavy recent shooting (+4.8%). The worry about Bellingham and Guler being rested has mostly gone, with Bellingham expected to start and Brahim a like-for-like option for Guler, while PSV are a little weaker in midfield without Mauro Junior. Nothing here is big enough to move, so I stay at 31.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 12.7 on target, with Madrid's sharp recent finishing counted (+8%). Mbappe and Vinicius both start and PSV keep their usual attacking set-up, which is what the numbers assume, so I stay at 12.7.
